## Requirement and source

Link the original request and accepted corrections. State the user operation or document requirement this change addresses.

## Resulting change

Explain what changes and why. Link the affected Linear issue without claiming acceptance from its status.

## Validation evidence

- Revision inspected:
- Relevant acceptance criterion → observation → retained evidence:
- Checks actually performed and results:
- Checks not performed and material limitations:
- Facts, inferences and unknowns:

Passing automated checks alone does not establish acceptance. Preserve evidence of the actual requested outcome.

## Delivery and remaining work

- Delivered:
- Verified conformity:
- Sustained value (dated evidence or unverified):
- Residual risk and exact next action:

Keep existing history and unrelated work. Identify any action requiring additional authorization only after preparing the exact proposed change.
